# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.5 Worker 2: Maritime Warfare, Letters of Marque, Strait Toll CBs & 5 Historical Expeditions (oe_nav2_). Generated by gen_v125_maritime.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Interaction 1: Issue Letters of Marque (hostile maritime commerce raiding; grants target anti-piracy CB)
oe_nav2_issue_letters_of_marque = {
	type = diplomacy
	category = CATEGORY_HOSTILE_ACTIONS
	block_when_at_war = no
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 24
	use_in_automation = no

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			has_ports = yes
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			has_ports = yes
			gold >= 75
			navy_size >= 5
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_nav2_marque_cd
		years = 6
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_military }
		visible = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			country_exists = this
			has_ports = yes
			scope:actor = { within_diplomatic_range = prev }
		}
		enabled = {
			NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:actor } }
			NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:actor }
			NOT = { scope:actor = { is_subject_of = prev } }
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_nav2_marque_harassed }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
			scope:actor = {
				add_gold = -75
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_nav2_letters_of_marque_active
					years = 5
					mode = replace
				}
				save_scope_as = oe_nav2_marque_issuer
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_nav2_marque_harassed
					years = 5
					mode = replace
				}
				add_opinion = {
					target = scope:actor
					modifier = oe_nav2_b_letters_of_marque
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_ports = yes
						navy_size > 0
					}
					add_casus_belli = {
						target = scope:actor
						type = casus_belli:oe_nav2_cb_suppress_piracy
						years = 5
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = oe_nav2_marque_victim
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nav2.1
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = -40
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				scope:actor = {
					gold >= 150
					OR = {
						is_at_war_with = scope:recipient
						is_rival_of = scope:recipient
					}
				}
			}
			add = 65
		}
	}
}

# Interaction 2: Form Joint Anti-Piracy Convoy (friendly mutual convoy pact; clears marque harassment)
oe_nav2_joint_antipiracy_convoy = {
	type = diplomacy
	category = CATEGORY_FRIENDLY_ACTIONS
	block_when_at_war = yes
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 24
	use_in_automation = no

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			has_ports = yes
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			has_ports = yes
			at_war = no
			gold >= 60
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_nav2_convoy_cd
		years = 8
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info }
		visible = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			country_exists = this
			has_ports = yes
			scope:actor = { within_diplomatic_range = prev }
		}
		enabled = {
			at_war = no
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
			NOT = { is_rival_of = scope:actor }
			gold >= 60
			opinion = { target = scope:actor value >= 25 }
		}
	}

	diplo_chance = {
		base = -5
		opinion = 0.25
		same_religion = 5
		diplomatic_reputation = 2
		in_debt = -25
	}

	accept = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				scope:recipient = { has_country_modifier = oe_nav2_marque_harassed }
			}
			add = 30
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				scope:recipient = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:actor } }
			}
			add = 20
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
			scope:actor = {
				add_gold = -60
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_nav2_antipiracy_convoy_mod
					years = 8
					mode = replace
				}
				add_opinion = {
					target = scope:recipient
					modifier = oe_nav2_b_joint_convoy
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_nav2_marque_harassed }
					remove_country_modifier = oe_nav2_marque_harassed
				}
				save_scope_as = oe_nav2_convoy_partner_a
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				add_gold = -60
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_nav2_antipiracy_convoy_mod
					years = 8
					mode = replace
				}
				add_opinion = {
					target = scope:actor
					modifier = oe_nav2_b_joint_convoy
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_nav2_marque_harassed }
					remove_country_modifier = oe_nav2_marque_harassed
				}
				save_scope_as = oe_nav2_convoy_partner_b
			}
			scope:actor = {
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nav2.2
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = -30
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				scope:actor = {
					has_country_modifier = oe_nav2_marque_harassed
					gold >= 120
				}
			}
			add = 55
		}
	}
}

# Interaction 3: Negotiate Strait Passage & Factory Charter (economic treaty with strait sovereign; rejection feeds CB)
oe_nav2_negotiate_strait_charter = {
	type = diplomacy
	category = CATEGORY_ECONOMY_ACTIONS
	block_when_at_war = yes
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36
	use_in_automation = no

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			has_ports = yes
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			has_ports = yes
			at_war = no
			gold >= 150
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_nav2_strait_charter_cd
		years = 10
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_trade }
		visible = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			country_exists = this
			oe_nav2_controls_major_strait = yes
			scope:actor = { within_diplomatic_range = prev }
		}
		enabled = {
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
			NOT = { is_rival_of = scope:actor }
			opinion = { target = scope:actor value >= 0 }
		}
	}

	diplo_chance = {
		base = 0
		opinion = 0.25
		diplomatic_reputation = 2
		same_religion = 5
		recipient_at_war = -15
	}

	accept = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				scope:recipient = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:actor } }
			}
			add = 20
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				scope:recipient = { gold < 200 }
			}
			add = 15
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
			scope:actor = {
				add_gold = -150
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_nav2_strait_free_passage
					years = 10
					mode = replace
				}
				add_opinion = {
					target = scope:recipient
					modifier = oe_nav2_b_strait_charter
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = oe_nav2_strait_charter_partner
					value = scope:recipient
					years = 10
				}
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				add_gold = 150
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_nav2_strait_charter_toll
					years = 10
					mode = replace
				}
				add_opinion = {
					target = scope:actor
					modifier = oe_nav2_b_strait_charter
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = oe_nav2_strait_charter_client
					value = scope:actor
					years = 10
				}
			}
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
			scope:actor = {
				set_variable = {
					name = oe_nav2_strait_breach_target
					value = scope:recipient
					years = 5
				}
				save_scope_as = oe_nav2_charter_petitioner
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				save_scope_as = oe_nav2_strait_holder
			}
			scope:actor = {
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nav2.3
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = -25
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				scope:actor = {
					monthly_trade_income >= 15
					gold >= 300
					NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_nav2_strait_free_passage }
				}
			}
			add = 45
		}
	}
}
